package.description: Video player for FG4 cards and MGB devices.

en-US.description: Video player for FG4 cards and MGB devices.
en-US.longDescription:
DQ Viewer is a simple video player especially designated for playing video streams from Digiteq Automotive FG4 grabber cards and MGB devices.

Features:
- Play local cameras streams (DirectShow / video4linux).
- Play network streams with predefined setup for MGB devices.
- Record the streams to h264 or MPEG2.
- Stream videos to video outputs.
- Support for DEM files (SRTM HGT).
- Capture video frames snapshots to PNG.
- Configure FG4 devices.
en-US.name: DQViewer
